ui.admin.general.evite_qu_un_joueur_attende: Prevents a player from waiting indefinitely for a spell cooldown before acting. Applies to characters and monsters alike (red bar under the Flee button in combat).

ui.admin.general.l_endurance_maximale_se_re: Maximum stamina is now set individually for each character in the « Party and items » page.
ui.admin.general.plafonne_a_2_points_maximu: Capped at 2 points maximum regardless of this setting: the basic physical attack must never fully block a character who is out of stamina.
ui.admin.general.le_cout_en_endurance_des: The stamina cost of spells/abilities is now set individually in the « Spells and abilities » page.
ui.admin.general.ex_gain_de_1_tous: E.g.: gain of 1 every 3 moves = slower regeneration. Randomly generated dungeons use this stricter interval by default.
ui.admin.general.en_dessous_du_cout_requis: Below the required cost, a spell or ability is blocked until stamina recovers (the basic physical attack, however, always remains possible — see the note above).
ui.admin.general.bonus_endurance_a_la_fin: Stamina bonus at the end of a fight, as a % of each character's max stamina — varies with the difficulty chosen in a random dungeon (the Original Dungeon and hand-made dungeons use the “Normal” value).
ui.admin.general.regeneration_partielle_de_: Partial HP/stamina regeneration on first arrival on a level (stairs/archway), as a % of max — granted only once per level and per game.
ui.admin.general.a_chaque_niveau_gagne_par: Each time a character gains a level, their base stats (Strength/Dexterity/Constitution/Intelligence) and base stamina increase slightly — HP and damage benefit indirectly (via Constitution/Strength), on top of their own level-based progression.
ui.admin.general.stats_de_base_points_cumul: Base stats — points accumulated per level
ui.admin.general.ex_0_4_force_dex: E.g. 0.4 = Str/Dex/Con/Int increase together by +1 every 2-3 levels (fractional accumulation, never lost).
ui.admin.general.cout_en_or_demande_par: Cost (in gold) asked by the Talent Master to change an already chosen talent — increases with the tier concerned (×1 at level 5, ×5 at level 25).
ui.admin.general.placees_dans_les_niveaux_t: Placed in levels (item type « Fountain »), they fully restore HP and stamina for the whole party, then need this delay to recharge.
ui.admin.general.chance_de_desamorcer_un_pi: Chance for the whole party (living characters) to disarm a trap. A natural 20 always succeeds, a natural 1 always fails.
ui.admin.general.dexterite_prise_en_compte_: Dexterity counted (max points above 10, per character)
ui.admin.general.degats_un_piege_pourcentag: Trap damage: percentage of the hit character's max HP (chosen at random). The fixed damage set on each trap acts as a guaranteed minimum.
ui.admin.general.degats_un_piege_minimum_de: Trap damage — minimum (% of max HP)
ui.admin.general.degats_un_piege_maximum_de: Trap damage — maximum (% of max HP)
ui.admin.general.applique_aux_donjons_gener: Applies to randomly generated dungeons: chance that a boss's guaranteed loot is a legendary item (unique name, boosted stats, special bonus). Legendary items can also be set manually on any weapon/armor/jewelry, in the Party and items and Levels pages.
ui.admin.general.la_mort_un_monstre_reparti: A monster's death splits its XP among all characters who contributed to the fight (damage dealt, but also healing given), proportionally. The ratio below determines how many healed HP count as 1 damage point for this calculation — useful for valuing healing skills and spells.

ui.ui.generator_dialog.facultatif_jusqu_a_2: Optional: up to 2 stackable modifiers, each a real trade-off to vary the experience. The choice stays active for this whole expedition.

ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_2_q: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I?

ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_4_q: I am always ahead of you, yet no one can ever see me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_5_q: I belong to you, yet others use me more than you do. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_6_q: I go up and down without ever moving. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_7_q: I have cities without houses, forests without trees, seas without water. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_8_q: The more I dry, the wetter I get. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_9_q: I die the moment you speak my name. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_10_q: The hotter I am, the fresher I am. What am I?

ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_11_q: I fly without wings and cry without eyes. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_12_q: I am full of holes, yet I hold water. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_13_q: I am tall when I am young and short when I am old. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_14_q: I have no lungs but I need air; I have no mouth but water kills me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_15_q: I am born in the sky, I die in the earth, and I make everything I touch grow. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_16_q: I whistle without lips, I push without hands, and I make the leaves dance. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_17_q: I follow you everywhere, I grow long at dusk and vanish in the dark. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_18_q: I change my face every night, sometimes round, sometimes thin, and I am never quite the same. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_19_q: I shine all night without a flame, and the day hides me without putting me out. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_20_q: I come from water, I return to water, and the sun makes me melt. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_21_q: I have a foot but no legs, a head but no hair, and the higher I am, the more snow lies on me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_22_q: My arms are branches, my skin is bark, and my hair falls every autumn. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_23_q: I run without legs, I sing without a voice, and I never return to my source. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_24_q: I measure time without hands, and every time I am turned over, I start again. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_25_q: I have two hands but cannot clap, a face but no mouth. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_26_q: I repeat everything you do without ever saying a word, and yet I am not you. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_27_q: I have no door and no window, yet someone lives inside; I must be broken to set them free. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_28_q: I grow underground and I have eyes, but I see nothing. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_29_q: White as linen, light as a feather, I fall in silence and cover the world. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_30_q: I hide the paths without ever closing them, I have no body and yet you can walk inside me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_31_q: I only appear after the rain, I have seven colours, and nobody has ever reached my end. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_32_q: I am a mountain that spits out molten rock. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_33_q: I am lighter than a feather, yet the strongest man cannot hold me for more than a minute. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_34_q: Thirty-two white soldiers live in a red cave; they clatter and chew. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_35_q: Two windows without shutters that close by themselves and let in only light. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_36_q: If you reveal me, I vanish, and yet I never weighed anything. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_37_q: I heal all wounds, but in the end I kill everyone. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_38_q: The more you use me, the stronger I grow; when you forget me, I weaken. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_39_q: I beat throughout your life without ever resting, and I stop when you stop. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_40_q: I can be broken or kept, but I can only be given by speaking me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_41_q: I take you everywhere without you moving, and I vanish when you wake. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_42_q: Every night I take a part of your life, and yet you thank me for it. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_43_q: I am small, I pass from hand to hand, and I open only one door. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_44_q: I open and I close, I guard without keeping watch, and everyone passes through me without a word of thanks. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_45_q: I have a guard but no soldier, a point but no pencil, a blade but no grass. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_46_q: I take every blow without returning a single one, and yet I am precious in battle. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_47_q: I fly without wings, I sting without a stinger, and I never return to my master. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_48_q: I guide your steps in the dark, but the more I light your way, the more I burn away. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_49_q: The one who makes me sells me, the one who buys me never uses me, and the one who uses me does not know it. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_50_q: I guard a pile of gold I never spend, I spit fire without a forge, and I sleep on my hoard. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_51_q: I pass through walls without breaking them, I weep without tears and I haunt without a home. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_52_q: I have no flesh left, I stand upright, and I laugh without a mouth. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_53_q: I fear garlic, sunlight and stakes, and I cast no reflection in mirrors. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_54_q: Human by day, beast on nights of the full moon. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_55_q: I pose riddles and devour those who fail; I have the body of a lion and wings. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_56_q: I am poured into a vial and drunk in one gulp, and I heal or kill depending on who brews me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_57_q: I am made of wood but I am not a tree, and I cast spells without ever speaking. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_58_q: I have leaves but I am not a tree, a spine but no legs, and I tell tales without speaking. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_59_q: I weep black to write the laws of kings. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_60_q: I sleep in the belfry and I sing when I am struck. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_61_q: I have rungs but no prison, I never move and yet I lift you up. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_62_q: I help you cross the water without getting wet, and I never move. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_63_q: I am a hole full of water where a coin is thrown to make a wish. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_64_q: I have two faces, I am tossed to decide, and I pass from hand to hand. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_65_q: I have six faces and dots but no point of view; I am thrown to try one's luck. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_66_q: I fall into the water so the ship stays in place, and the deeper I fall, the firmer it holds. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_67_q: When the wind fills me, I drive the ship forward without moving myself. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_68_q: My arms turn without tiring and, thanks to the wind, I turn grain into flour. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_69_q: I am thrown on snow and into soup; I make dishes tasty, but too much of me spoils everything. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_70_q: I am kneaded, I rise, I am baked, and I am broken at every meal. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_71_q: I flow, I take the shape of the vessel, I freeze in winter, and without me no life is possible. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_72_q: A shepherd has fifteen sheep; all but eight die. How many does he have left?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_73_q: I am a number: if you double me and take away two, ten remain. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_74_q: I am a number: if you add five to me, you get twelve. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_75_q: Three cats catch three mice in three minutes. How many cats does it take to catch a hundred mice in a hundred minutes?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_76_q: What is double the half of seven?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_77_q: There are three apples on a table; you take two. How many do you hold in your hand?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_78_q: A snail climbs three metres by day and slips back two metres by night. The well is five metres deep. In how many days does it get out?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_79_q: A rooster lays an egg on top of a pointed roof. Which way does the egg fall?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_79_a: Neither, roosters do not lay eggs
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_80_q: How many months of the year have twenty-eight days?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_81_q: Which weighs more: a kilo of feathers or a kilo of lead?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_82_q: How many legs do two spiders and one horse have together?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_83_q: In a race, you overtake the runner in second place. What position are you in now?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_84_q: A traveller has two bags: one holds three gold coins, the other holds twice as many. How many coins does he have in all?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_88_q: What is half of half of half of 80?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_89_q: I have teeth but never bite, and I untangle hair. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_90_q: I have a needle but I do not sew, and you follow me so as not to get lost. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_91_q: I have an eye but I see nothing, and I pull a thread behind me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_92_q: I am black when you buy me, red when you use me, and grey when you throw me away. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_93_q: Filled with a gas lighter than air, I float away if you let go of me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_94_q: I travel around the world while staying in my corner. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_95_q: Short, bearded, smith and miner, I love gold, ale and underground halls. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_96_q: Pointed ears, bow in hand, I live for centuries in the woods. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_97_q: Small, green, cunning and thieving, I hide in caves with my kin. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_98_q: I live under a bridge, I am slow to understand, and I turn to stone in the sun. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_99_q: I traded my life for endless power, and my soul rests in a hidden object. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_100_q: I wear shining armour, I hold a sacred oath and I heal through the light. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_101_q: Quiet as a shadow, I pick locks and vanish before dawn. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_102_q: My voice charms crowds, my lute serves as my weapon, and my songs do more than entertain. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_103_q: I draw my strength from words and stars, and my long beard often hides secrets. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_104_q: I speak to trees, beasts and wind, and nature obeys me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_105_q: I have neither spell nor armour, but my rage is enough to split an oak. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_106_q: I pose as a chest, but beware whoever opens me: I bite. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_107_q: I am made of clay or stone, I have no soul and I obey only my master. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_108_q: I watch over cathedral roofs, stone by day, alive by night. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_109_q: Cut off one of my heads and two grow back. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_110_q: I die in the flames and I am reborn from my ashes. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_111_q: I have a single horn on my brow, and only a pure soul may approach me. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_112_q: My song lures sailors onto the reefs; I am half woman, half fish. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_113_q: My gaze turns to stone, and my hair is made of snakes. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_114_q: Half man, half bull, I prowl a labyrinth. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_115_q: Half man, half horse, I gallop and shoot with a bow. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_116_q: I have three dog heads and I guard the gates of the underworld. What am I?
ui.ui.trap_puzzle.riddle_117_q: I am a horse that flies among the clouds. What am I?

ui.ui.settings.preset_hint_auto: At each launch, the game measures this machine and sets the quality to aim for at least 60 frames per second with standard (1024) textures. It only goes lower if needed, and only goes higher when there is real headroom.

ui.ui.settings.preset_hint_high: Full rendering: torch and spell lights, anti-aliasing, sharp textures.

ui.ui.party_modal.tip_force: Strength: minimum damage = Strength ÷ 3 (rounded down) + 1 every 2 levels.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_dex: Dexterity: maximum damage = minimum + 2 + Dex ÷ 4. Above 10: +1 % crit per point and +0.8 % dodge per point (capped at 25 % and 20 %). Also used for traps.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_con: Constitution: HP = 10 + 3 × Con + 4 per level gained. Above 10: 1 % guard per point (capped at 25 %), reducing all damage taken.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_int: Intelligence: spell power = Int ÷ 3 (rounded down) − 1 (Int 10 = +2). Added to damage, healing, shields and stamina restored. Also used to dispel and probe traps.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_speed: Speed: the class speed, plus gear and effects. It fills the initiative gauge: the higher it is, the earlier the character acts in the round.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_attaque: Attack damage: base %d–%d (Strength and Dex) + gear %d–%d + talents %d–%d.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_critique: Critical hit chance (double damage): %d %% from Dexterity + %d %% from talents and gear.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_esquive: Chance to avoid a monster's physical attack entirely. Comes from Dexterity.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_garde: Reduction of all damage taken, physical and magical. Comes from Constitution.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_reduc: Damage taken reduced by: %d %% resistance (talents) + %d %% guard. Cap %d %%.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_puissance: Bonus added to each spell: %d from Intelligence + %d from gear and talents + %d from level.
ui.ui.party_modal.tip_vol_vie: Share of damage dealt returned as HP (talents).

ui.ui.stat_explain.rule_atk: Attack damage, rolled between the minimum and maximum. Minimum: Strength ÷ 3 + level. Maximum: minimum + 2 + Dex ÷ 4. Gear and talents add to it.
ui.ui.stat_explain.rule_crit: Chance for an attack to be a critical hit. 1 % per Dexterity point above 10, plus talents.
ui.ui.stat_explain.rule_spell: Bonus added to spells. Damage and healing: Intelligence + gear/talents + level. Shields and stamina restores: Intelligence only.
ui.ui.stat_explain.rule_stamina: Pool that pays for spells. It refills over time and by resting; its maximum depends on class, talents and game mode.
ui.ui.monster_info_modal.tip_dex: Dexterity: maximum damage = minimum %d + 1 + floor(%d ÷ 3.3) = %d. It also sets speed when the sheet gives none (current speed: %d).

content.content.la_mort_un_monstre_repartit: A monster's death splits its XP between all characters who contributed to the fight (damage dealt, but also healing done), proportionally. This ratio sets how many HP healed are worth 1 point of damage in this calculation.

content.content.coller_ci_dessous_un_code: Paste a received code below to load this dungeon into the administration (replaces the current configuration):
content.content.le_groupe_qui_demarre_l: The party that starts the adventure. Spells marked with a padlock are learned automatically at a given level (class progression) and cannot be assigned at the start. Maximum %d spells per character.
content.content.sorts_et_competences_connus_au: Spells and abilities known at the start
content.content.cette_classe_n_a_aucun: This class has no allowed spell.
content.content.la_bibliotheque_objets_equipemen: The item library: characters' starting equipment, loot, shops. Items placed in levels are set in the « Levels » tab.
content.content.le_groupe_prend_la_fuite_chacun_: The party flees! Everyone loses half their stamina in the rush.
content.content.un_marchand_ambulant_vous_salue_: A traveling merchant greets you and sets up their stall.
content.content.une_cle_ne_peut_jamais_etre_jete: A key can never be discarded — it might still be needed.
content.content.ajouter_un_marchand_ambulant_sur: Add a traveling merchant on this level
content.content.retirer_le_marchand_de_ce_niveau: Remove the merchant from this level
content.content.protection_basique_cote_appareil: Basic device-side protection: avoids accidental access, this is not production security.
content.content.code_copie_dans_le_presse_papier: Code copied to the clipboard (%d characters).
content.content.une_presence_protectrice_emane_d: A protective presence emanates from the stone.
content.content.les_couleurs_d_un_ordre_oublie_f: The colors of a forgotten order still flutter.
content.content.les_flammes_s_accrochent_aux_lam: The flames cling to nearby blades.
content.content.une_vapeur_acre_enveloppe_vos_ar: An acrid vapor envelops your weapons.
content.content.un_tintement_apaisant_renforce_v: A soothing chime strengthens your resolve.
content.content.une_vision_fugace_accelere_vos_r: A fleeting vision quickens your reflexes.
content.content.une_armure_fantome_salue_votre_p: A phantom armor salutes your passage.
content.content.un_nom_oublie_grave_dans_la_pier: A forgotten name, carved in the cold stone.
content.content.le_metal_froid_porte_encore_des_: The cold metal still bears forge marks.
content.content.une_toile_epaisse_tapisse_le_rec: A thick web covers the corner.
content.content.un_tapis_elime_recouvre_la_pierr: A threadbare rug covers the cold stone.
content.content.un_vieux_tonneau_vide_abandonne_: An old empty barrel, left there.
content.content.des_ossements_jonchent_le_sol_de: Bones have long littered the floor.
